import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def dihed(a):
    res=[]; cur=a
    for _ in range(4):
        res.append(tuple(map(tuple,cur)))
        res.append(tuple([tuple(r[::-1]) for r in cur]))
        cur=[[cur[len(cur)-1-j][i] for j in range(len(cur[0]))] for i in range(len(cur))]
    return [v for v in res if len(set(v))==len(v) or True]
# Hypothesis: input grid (ignoring 8-block) has a global dihedral symmetry; the missing tile is the image of the block under that symmetry.
for n in [1,2,3,4]:
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; out=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    ys=[i for i,r in enumerate(inp) if 8 in r]; xs=[j for j in range(len(inp[0])) if any(r[j]==8 for r in inp)]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs); H,W=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    # test symmetries of the 30x30 non-8 grid: identity, rot180, hflip, vflip, transpose, anti-transpose
    def scores(tfm):
        tot=0; agree=0; okblock=True
        for i in range(30):
            for j in range(30):
                v=inp[i][j]
                ii,jj=tfm(i,j)
                tv=inp[ii][jj]
                tot+=1
                if v==tv: agree+=1
        return agree/tot,agree,tot
    tfs={
      'id':lambda i,j:(i,j),
      'rot180':lambda i,j:(29-i,29-j),
      'hflip':lambda i,j:(i,29-j),
      'vflip':lambda i,j:(29-i,j),
      'trans':lambda i,j:(j,i),
      'antitrans':lambda i,j:(29-j,29-i),
      'anti-h':lambda i,j:(29-i,j),
      'anti-v':lambda i,j:(i,29-j),
    }
    best=max(tfs.items(), key=lambda kv: scores(kv[1])[0])
    print(n,'best symmetry:',best[0],scores(best[1]))
